test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the decline of wildlife in India?

options.text: Incidence of forest fire is not a reason of declining wildlife

solution:
The correct answer is __**Incidence of forest fire is not a reason of declining wildlife.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **World Animal Fund's **most recent** Living Planet Report, **monitored **wildlife populations,** which include** mammals, birds, amphibians, reptiles, and fish,** have decreased by** 69% between 1970 and 2018.** 
 
• India has observed **population declines in 17 species **of freshwater** turtles as well as honeybees**.
 
• According to a survey, the** Himalayan area and the Western Ghats **are two of the country's **most vulnerable regions** for biodiversity loss.
 
• **Reasons **for the decline of wildlife in India:
 
 
• **The exploitation of forest resource**s increased as a result of** industrial and technological development.**
 
• More and more land was cleared for **farming, habitation, highways, mining, reservoirs, et**c.
 
• **Lopping for fodder and fuelwood** as well as the **removal of small timbe**r by the locals put increased pressure on the forests.
 
• **Domestic cattle grazing** has a negative impact on wildlife and its habitat.
 
• **Commercial poaching **is now very common.
 
• The **likelihood of forest fires**. 
 
 

***Incidence of forest fire is one of the reason of declining wildlife, so this option is incorrect.***
